title: HITL approval-stream sequence scenario
description: A cross-edition fixture that replays the stateful, persisted-append approval path: an initial execution state followed by a series of write-site steps. After every step both editions must satisfy the equality-at-every-write-site property (the message-scan projection and the event-stream projection agree) and author the same approval-event lifecycle. Unlike the input->output scenarios/, this exercises the carried-forward stream the production reconciler mutates in place.

execution_id.description: Stamped on the stream's identity at first seed (informational; never used for correlation). Passed to EnsureApprovalRequests at every step.

steps.description: Ordered write sites. The driver carries the authored approval_event_stream forward across steps; each step's status carries only the author-visible state (phase, messages, sub-agents) and never the stream.

status.description: The execution state at this write site (protojson). The driver attaches the carried-forward stream before authoring.

phase.description: ExecutionPhase enum constant, e.g. EXECUTION_WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL or EXECUTION_COMPLETED.

decisions.description: Present ⇒ this is a SubmitApproval write site; absent ⇒ an UpdateStatus write site. Each target tool call MUST be in its pre-decision gated state (WAITING_APPROVAL, APPROVAL_ACTION_UNSPECIFIED) in this step's status; the driver applies the decision to it exactly as the SubmitApproval handler does (set action/decided_at/approved_by, then author the decision event) AFTER EnsureApprovalRequests has run while the call is still gated. A multi-entry list models an APPROVE_ALL that resolves co-pending calls.

action.description: ApprovalAction enum constant: APPROVAL_ACTION_APPROVE | APPROVAL_ACTION_APPROVE_ALL | APPROVAL_ACTION_REJECT | APPROVAL_ACTION_SKIP.

pending_approvals.description: PendingApproval protos as protojson; the seam result after this step, compared order-independently by tool_call_id. A terminal phase projects an empty list.

stream_events.description: Normalized view of the authored approval_event_stream after this step, compared order-independently. Pins the lifecycle (type + correlation + retraction reason) without over-specifying internal event_id/timestamp/actor.

event_type.description: ApprovalEventType enum constant: APPROVAL_EVENT_TYPE_REQUESTED | APPROVAL_EVENT_TYPE_APPROVED | APPROVAL_EVENT_TYPE_REJECTED | APPROVAL_EVENT_TYPE_SKIPPED | APPROVAL_EVENT_TYPE_RETRACTED.

reason.description: ApprovalRetractionReason enum constant; present only on a RETRACTED event: APPROVAL_RETRACTION_REASON_SUB_AGENT_TERMINAL | APPROVAL_RETRACTION_REASON_SUPERSEDED.
